title: Sectors of a Circle Practice
description: Practice defining sectors and finding sector area from central angles.

questions.question: Which description best defines a sector of a circle?
options: A region bounded by two radii and the included arc
A line segment joining two points on the circle
The distance from the center to the circle
The full distance across the circle through the center
questions.explanation: A sector is the region inside a circle bounded by two radii and the arc between them.

questions.question: A sector has central angle 90 degrees. What fraction of the circle is the sector?
A sector with central angle 180 degrees is one half of the circle.
questions.explanation: Since 180/360 = 1/2, the sector is half of the circle.

questions.question: Simplify the sector fraction for a central angle of 60 degrees: 60/360 = ____.
What formula finds the exact area of a sector with central angle theta degrees and radius r?
questions.explanation: Sector area is the fraction theta/360 of the full circle area pi r^2.

questions.question: Find the exact area of a sector with central angle 90 degrees and radius 4.
questions.explanation: The sector is 1/4 of the circle. The full area is 16 pi, and 1/4 of 16 pi is 4 pi.

questions.question: Find the exact area of a sector with central angle 120 degrees and radius 3. Enter your answer in terms of pi.
questions.explanation: 120/360 = 1/3, and the full circle area is 9 pi. One third of 9 pi is 3 pi.

questions.question: Explain why a 45-degree sector is one eighth of a circle.
questions.correctAnswer: A full circle is 360 degrees, and 45/360 simplifies to 1/8, so the 45-degree sector is one eighth of the circle.
questions.explanation: Fraction-of-circle reasoning compares the sector's central angle to 360 degrees.
